entities.summary: Michael William Warfel is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who was bishop of the Diocese of Great Falls-Billings in Montana from 2007 to 2023. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Juneau in Alaska from 1996 to 2007.
